detail.title: 用于元件组装的设备和方法
detail.abstract: An apparatus (200,300,400) for component placement, comprising at least one container (212,412) configured to receive a number of components (103) to be placed on a target substrate (108, 111); an agitator (210,410) configured to exert a force impulse, such as an abrupt force impulse, on the container to cause the elements to change their position within the container; an inspection apparatus (216,316,416) configured to determine a position of the component within the container; and pick and place equipment (206,306,406) configured to pick one or more components from the container that meet predetermined position criteria and place the components on a target substrate. The invention also proposes a related method for component placement.
